integrity: The potential outcomes are exact decimals interpreted as rationals. The proof is a complete enumeration of all 20 actual assignments and all 20 sharp-null rerandomizations per assignment; the bundled checker reproduces the enumeration with Fraction arithmetic and verifies every studentizing denominator is positive.
scientific_limitations: The result is one exact six-unit counterexample for a balanced completely randomized treatment-control design and the inclusive Fisher randomization p-value. It is not a worst-case theorem, does not establish minimal sample size, and does not challenge the published asymptotic weak-null guarantee.
title: Exact finite-sample size inflation for a studentized Fisher randomization test
